description: The Caracara-class was among the first post-ICW hulls designed by Makosso-Warra. Faced with tremendous public relations (and profit) loss, the Caracara was assembled as a cheap, easy-to-fabricate salvaging ship to capitalise on the now scrap-rich frontier. There has been a major push from the Frontier Relations office to make the Caracara the new face of Makosso-Warra, symbolising their new-age commitment to cleaning up the damages of the past - though despite the peaceful propagandizing, fears over claimjumpers lead to the posting of a Vigilitas Security Officer on almost every vessel of the class.
